boqId.description: Stable id of the BOQ this context projects.

contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

revision.description: Revision counter of the BOQ (original wording preserved; revisions retain source identity).

sourceRecordRef.description: The VERBATIM incumbent record id when the BOQ originates from an external system of record.

sourceSystem.description: Source-of-record identity for the BOQ (e.g. `aise-internal`, `erp`, `bim-ifc`). Source BOQs remain authoritative for their own scope.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision, `Z` suffix only.
